<!-- Generated by codeflower-app's cmd/gendocs: do not edit. -->

Delete a project: its chats, agent logins, workspace and tasks, its settings, allowlist and env folder. Your input, output and code folders are not touched. It asks first, unless --yes is given.

A removal that is stopped (Ctrl+C) or fails leaves the rest hidden next to the project (.PROJECT.removing); running the same command again finishes it.


## Usage

```sh
codeflower projects remove PROJECT [flags]
```

Also available as `codeflower projects rm`.

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `-y, --yes` |  | remove without asking |

## Inherited flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--config string` |  | config directory with config.yaml (or set $CODEFLOWER_CONFIG; default ~/.codeflower) |
| `--env-dir string` |  | folder of the projects' env folders, for projects whose settings do not name one (or env_dir in the config) |
| `--projects-dir string` |  | folder of the projects started with --project (or projects_dir in the config; default ~/codeflower/projects) |
